name: BenchCAD 1.0
description: Reconstruct mechanical parts in code and answer image or code questions about their geometry.
input: CAD renders, part specifications or CAD code, by track
output: An executable design or task-specific answer
assessment: Executed solids are compared geometrically; numeric questions use answer accuracy.

name: BenchCAD 2.0
description: Produce parts and assemblies from drawings or images, and infer circuit connectivity from rendered boards.
input: Engineering drawings, rendered components or PCB images
output: An executable design or task-specific answer
assessment: Task-specific comparisons on the 100-case Core split; the public sample is not the reportable Core score.

name: BenchCAD 2.1
description: Complete the Core hardware engineering tasks with a revised standard harness, budget and cross-round reasoning.
input: Core hardware-design briefs and associated images
output: An executable design or task-specific answer
assessment: Mean Core score under the 2.1 budget and verifier. Standard and customized harnesses are reported separately.

name: FrontierCode 1.0
description: Solve engineering tasks authored by maintainers of real open-source repositories. Main, Extended and Diamond refer to nested subsets.
input: A repository and a maintainer-defined engineering brief
output: A proposed repository change
assessment: Maintainer-defined rubrics, with blocking criteria and a weighted score.

name: FrontierCode 1.1
description: Resolve repository tasks with revised scoring criteria; the publisher reports Main and Extended and drops the Diamond subset.
input: A repository and a maintainer-defined engineering brief
output: A proposed repository change
assessment: Revised weighted rubrics and blocking criteria, on the specified subset.

name: FrontierCode 2.0
description: Address a new set of engineering tasks drawn from a broader range of repositories and request categories.
input: A repository and a maintainer-defined engineering brief
output: A proposed repository change
assessment: Repository-specific checks assess whether the change is mergeable under the 2.0 protocol.

name: CursorBench 3.0
description: Solve the coding tasks in Cursor’s initial public changelog edition, emphasizing code edits, refactors and bug fixes.
input: Coding brief, repository context and tools
output: A code change or other task-specific response
assessment: Score under that CursorBench task set and run budget; latency and cost are reported separately.
date_note: Cursor’s public leaderboard changelog explicitly labels this as a Tasks entry, not a reporting-only pricing change.

name: CursorBench 3.1
description: The task suite adds codebase understanding, planning and code review; grading was also revised for some edit tasks.
input: Coding brief, repository context and tools
output: A code change or other task-specific response
assessment: Score under that CursorBench task set and run budget; latency and cost are reported separately.
date_note: Cursor’s public leaderboard changelog explicitly labels this as a Tasks entry, not a reporting-only pricing change.

name: CursorBench 3.2
description: The suite adds instruction-following and advanced tool-use problems.
input: Coding brief, repository context and tools
output: A code change or other task-specific response
assessment: Score under that CursorBench task set and run budget; latency and cost are reported separately.
date_note: Cursor’s public leaderboard changelog explicitly labels this as a Tasks entry, not a reporting-only pricing change.

name: CursorBench 4.0
description: The suite introduces longer-horizon tasks covering code edits, investigation, intent understanding and design adherence.
input: Coding brief, repository context and tools
output: A code change or other task-specific response
assessment: Score under that CursorBench task set and run budget; latency and cost are reported separately.
date_note: Cursor’s public leaderboard changelog explicitly labels this as a Tasks entry, not a reporting-only pricing change.

name: CursorBench 4.1
description: The release changes instruction-following problems and increases the agent time limit.
input: Coding brief, repository context and tools
output: A code change or other task-specific response
assessment: Score under that CursorBench task set and run budget; latency and cost are reported separately.
date_note: Cursor’s public leaderboard changelog explicitly labels this as a Tasks entry, not a reporting-only pricing change.

name: GDPval-AA 1.0
description: Produce workplace deliverables in Artificial Analysis’ agentic implementation of OpenAI’s public GDPval tasks.
input: A professional brief, reference files and the AA agent environment
output: A professional work product
assessment: Blind pairwise assessments summarized as a relative rating under the original AA protocol.
date_note: The publisher announced the GDPval-AA leaderboard on December 10. Its independently dated Stirrup article that day confirms the GDPval-AA evaluation was being released later that day.

name: GDPval-AA 2.0
description: Use the v2 professional-work environment with revised dependencies and a larger turn budget.
input: A professional brief, reference files and the AA agent environment
output: A professional work product
assessment: Pairwise evaluations by a panel of judges; the v2 rating scale is anchored to human expert performance at 1000.
date_note: The source explicitly announces the GDPval-AA v2 upgrade.

name: GDPval-AA 2.1
description: The professional-work task protocol is retained while the relative ratings are recalibrated.
input: A professional brief, reference files and the AA agent environment
output: A professional work product
assessment: Crowd-BT fitted ratings with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max) fixed at 1600; do not equate the Elo scale to v2.0.
date_note: The AA methodology dates this change to September under Index v4.3.2; AA had reported v4.3.2 by September 29. Exact launch day not established.

name: Finance Agent 1.0
description: Research financial questions using public company filings and tools.
input: A financial research question, filings and search tools
output: A supported numerical or textual answer
assessment: Reference and rubric-based accuracy on the named Finance Agent dataset.
date_note: Original benchmark paper arXiv v1 timestamp.

name: Finance Agent 1.1
description: Answer revised professional finance questions with clarified dates, updated tool use and explicit answer submission.
input: A financial research question, filings and search tools
output: A supported numerical or textual answer
assessment: Model-based grading with revised rounding guidance and a three-evaluation vote.
date_note: Substantive author data commit for FAB v1.1. An earlier code commit labeled v1.1 is not sufficient to establish the revised dataset.

name: Finance Agent 2.0
description: Research analyst workflows including comparables, precedents, earnings and disclosures rather than the original retrieval-focused categories.
input: A financial research question, filings and search tools
output: A supported numerical or textual answer
assessment: Accuracy under the v2 tasks and financial research harness.
date_note: Vals’ own index changelog says Finance Agent v2 was in use on May 13. A component result is not the index aggregate.

name: Finance Agent 2.1
description: Answer professional finance tasks under revised questions, rubrics and judging for hedged answers.
input: A financial research question, filings and search tools
output: A supported numerical or textual answer
assessment: Accuracy using the v2.1 judge panel and updated grading rubric.
date_note: Vals’ index changelog records the replacement with v2.1 on October 19; this is an available-by bound, not the later leaderboard refresh date.

name: Agents’ Last Exam 1.0
description: Complete multi-step professional workflows across real software environments.
input: A workplace task, tools and domain-specific software
output: A completed task artifact and application state
assessment: Task-specific verifiers assess the resulting work on the corresponding release.

name: Agents’ Last Exam 1.1
description: The finalized v1.1 scope has 122 active tasks after 30 retirements. It revises task instructions, environments, verification and data for selected workflows.
input: A workplace task, tools and domain-specific software
output: A completed task artifact and application state
assessment: Task-specific verifiers assess the resulting work on the corresponding release.
date_note: October 14 commit explicitly pins the complete final 122-task v1.1 source tree. Earlier September 19 v1.1 assets and October 8 migrations existed before this frozen scope.

name: Toolathlon
description: Carry out a request by coordinating tools across applications. The final Verified release revised prompts, checks and reference outcomes.
input: A task and an initialized software workspace
output: Tool actions and a completed workspace task
assessment: Task-specific scripts verify the outcome

name: DeepSWE
description: Implement an original engineering task in an existing repository. The tests check the requested behavior rather than matching a reference patch.
input: A repository at a fixed revision and an engineering brief
output: A committed code change
assessment: Pass rate under task-specific behavioral tests for the originally released tasks and grading protocol.

name: PostTrainBench
description: A CLI agent post-trains a supplied base model for a target benchmark within a fixed compute budget.
input: Small base model, target task and fixed compute
output: Post-trained model
assessment: Held-out target performance aggregated across model–task pairs

name: CWE-bench v2
description: Assess security fixes to real repositories while checking that previously working behavior still holds.
input: Repository and defensive audit task
output: Code changes resolving the identified weakness
assessment: Programmatic security and regression checks

name: Toolathlon-Verified
description: Carry out long multi-application workflows using the final verified prompts, reference outcomes and evaluators.
input: A task and an initialized software workspace
output: Tool actions and a completed workspace task
assessment: Task-specific scripts verify the outcome under the revised final release.

name: DeepSWE 1.1
description: Complete the original engineering tasks under a revised execution and grading protocol.
input: A repository snapshot and an engineering task
output: A committed code change
assessment: Tests grade the submitted patch in a clean environment, not the agent’s transient workspace.

name: PostTrainBench 1.1
description: Post-train a supplied model under a fixed compute budget with explicit contamination, API-use and model-identity checks.
input: A base model, target task and fixed compute budget
output: A post-trained model
assessment: Held-out target scores under v1.1 integrity checks.

name: PostTrainBench 1.2
description: Post-train small base models on six reweighted benchmark targets with revised HumanEval scoring.
input: A base model, target task and fixed compute budget
output: A post-trained model
assessment: Held-out performance averaged over up to five final-evaluation seeds with revised contamination adjudication.

name: CWE-bench v0
description: The original defensive assessment evaluates repository fixes across categories of software weakness.
input: A repository and a defensive repair requirement
output: A corrected software artifact
assessment: Programmatic checks assess the requested repair and previously supported behavior.

name: CWE-bench v1
description: A revised defensive assessment of repository fixes, with expanded task coverage and updated programmatic checks.
input: A repository and a defensive repair requirement
output: A corrected software artifact
assessment: Programmatic checks assess the requested repair and previously supported behavior.
